connections.name: Deezer catalog
connections.description: Search, artists, albums, tracks, charts and artwork from Deezer's public catalog. No account needed.

connections.name: TorBox
connections.description: Plays music from your TorBox account and from releases already cached on TorBox.

connections.name: Navidrome / Subsonic
connections.description: Plays from your own music server: Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic or anything else that speaks the Subsonic API.

connections.name: LRCLIB lyrics
connections.description: Synced and plain lyrics from LRCLIB, a free community database. No account needed.

connections.name: Spotify playlists
connections.description: Reads public Spotify playlist links so you can import them. Up to the first 100 songs of a playlist.

connections.name: Apple Music playlists
connections.description: Reads public Apple Music playlist links so you can import them. Up to the songs shown on the playlist's web page.

connections.name: Deezer playlists
connections.description: Reads public Deezer playlist links so you can import them.

connections.name: ListenBrainz playlists
connections.description: Reads public ListenBrainz playlist links so you can import them.

connections.name: Last.fm
connections.description: Scrobbles what you play to your Last.fm profile.

connections.name: ListenBrainz
connections.description: Sends what you play to your ListenBrainz listening history.

connections.name: Discord
connections.description: Posts what you are listening to in a Discord channel.

connections.name: ntfy notifications
connections.description: Sends a push notification to your phone when a song starts, through ntfy.

connections.name: Webhook
connections.description: Posts every play to an address of yours as JSON, for Home Assistant, n8n, Zapier or your own scripts.
